name: Jesus Crist Fully Man Fully God
overview: Scripture reveals that Jesus Christ is both fully God and fully man, embodying the fullness of the Godhead in bodily form (Colossians 2:9). As the eternal Word who was with God and was God from the beginning (John 1:1), He took on human flesh and lived among us (John 1:14), sharing in our humanity to accomplish salvation by defeating death and the devil (Hebrews 2:14). Isaiah prophesies His divine titles, affirming His deity and eternal reign (Isaiah 9:6), while Jesus Himself promises eternal life and protection to His followers (John 10:28).
